QuestionStmt.S: Calculate the number of unit cells in $1 \text{ cm}^3$ volume of an element if unit cell edge length is $4.0 \times 10^{-8} \text{ cm}$.

Solution.S:
Given:
Volume of sample, $V = 1$ cm³
Edge length of unit cell, $a = 4.0 \times 10^{-8}$ cm

Volume of one unit cell = $a^3 = (4.0 \times 10^{-8})^3 = 64 \times 10^{-24} = 6.4 \times 10^{-23}$ cm³

Number of unit cells = $\frac{\text{Total volume}}{\text{Volume of one unit cell}} = \frac{1}{6.4 \times 10^{-23}} = 0.15625 \times 10^{23} = 1.5625 \times 10^{22}$

Thus the correct option is B: $1.56 \times 10^{22}$.
